text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
We got sooo many, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
We got sooo many, Big Sister♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
See? Isn't Curren super cute
with her plushie~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then, as thanks for making them so cute...
I'll give one to you too, Big Brother. Which one do you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then, as thanks for making them so cute...
I'll give one to you too, Big Sister. Which one do you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know!
It doesn't have to be someone from this group, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The cutest girl "right here"!
I'll let you choose, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.text:

I'll let you choose, Big Sister♪
